acquisition.frozen_artifacts: deterministic gzip derived dataset phase1b_attempt_data/attempts_<source season>.jsonl.gz + provenance.jsonl.gz + phase1b_attempt_data_manifest.json (no raw blobs committed)
acquisition.never_fetched: unrelated games; no full-season crawl; no target-game PBP
acquisition.required_source_games: for every sampled target candidate row, the player's last <=10 prior all-team NHL appearances in the frozen skater table with source_start + 210 min <= target cutoff (T = target start - 90 min, i.e. source_start <= target_start - 300 min) and source_game_id != target_game_id; the UNION over the whole bounded sample, de-duplicated
acquisition.retries: up to 4 attempts per game with back-off; every response cached; provenance (url, retrieval timestamp, sha256, bytes, HTTP status) stored per game
acquisition.unobtainable_source_game: reported; its appearances are treated as having no attempt data (excluded from every attempt window identically for A1; A0 unaffected); if more than 0.5% of required source games are unobtainable the quality gate FAILS and the task STOPS before performance

bootstrap.pooled_unit: all validation games of D1-D4 combined (sampled games only)
bootstrap.scheme: identical to Phase 1A: game-level per-game mean CRPS difference (A1 - A0), Monday-based calendar weeks, 2-consecutive-calendar-week moving-block bootstrap, 10000 replicates

bug_policy: A code bug found after performance numbers are seen may be fixed only if the fix is independent of those numbers; the original and corrected results are both reported; no design choice above may change after performance is inspected.

data_exposure_rules.excluded: 2024 and 2025 targets are completely excluded from Phase 1B-A performance, feature selection and pass/fail decisions (they were exposed by Phase 1A and are not untouched holdouts for a new challenger); no 2024/2025 challenger performance is computed or inspected
data_exposure_rules.history_only: 2017 (and any earlier source season already inside the frozen dataset) is lag-history / warm-up only
data_exposure_rules.labels: target labels come from the frozen Phase 1A official SOG dataset (phase1a_data/*.jsonl.gz); target-game PBP NEVER creates a feature for that target

derived_dataset.definitions: events of type shot-on-goal, goal, missed-shot, blocked-shot with periodType != SO (shootout excluded exactly as Phase 0B); shooter = details.shootingPlayerId (goal: scoringPlayerId); a BLOCKED shot is attributed to the shooter, never the blocker; sog_from_pbp = shot-on-goal + goal; shot_attempts = shot-on-goal + goal + missed-shot + blocked-shot; players with no events get zeros; shooters absent from the frozen skater table: goalies (rosterSpots position G) are excluded and counted, any other absent shooter with SOG>0 is a genuine mismatch
derived_dataset.row: one row per (game_id, player_id) for every skater row of the FROZEN skater-game table of each fetched source game

execution_order: acquire the bounded PBP source-game set and freeze the derived dataset + manifest
raw signal diagnostics on training portions

features.ATTEMPTS_MEAN_APP10: mean shot_attempts over the last <=10 appearances (missing if none)
features.ATTEMPTS_MEAN_APP5: mean shot_attempts over the last <=5 such appearances (missing if there is none)
features.ATTEMPTS_PER60_APP10: 3600 * SUM(shot_attempts over usable appearances) / SUM(frozen total TOI seconds over those SAME usable appearances); usable = among the last <=10 appearances, TOI present and > 0 and attempt data available; RATIO OF SUMS; missing if the TOI sum is 0 or there is no usable appearance
features.N_ATTEMPT_APPEARANCES_10: NOT used (the explicit missing-indicator columns already distinguish missingness; exactly four features are registered)
features.ON_NET_RATE_APP10: SUM(sog_from_pbp over the last <=10 appearances with attempt data) / SUM(shot_attempts over those appearances); if total attempts = 0 -> MISSING (not zero)
features.window: the same all-team, completed-before-cutoff last <=10 appearances as SOG_MEAN_APP10 (frozen skater table; cutoff source_start <= target_start - 300 min; target game excluded by construction)

forbidden: 2024 or 2025 target performance, features or decisions
any change to a Phase 1A artifact or hyperparameter
touching main, deploying anything, or touching the live NFL / NHL collectors, their state branches or workflows

locked_phase1a_context.2025: BURNED by Phase 1A; never touched here
locked_phase1a_context.B3: old Phase 1A context only; not a candidate, must not influence any decision here
locked_phase1a_context.incumbent: B2 (Poisson mean + NB2 dispersion wrapper), HISTORICAL_CHAMPION

also: randomized-PIT KS (deterministic v from SHA256(model_id|game_id|player_id), model ids A0/A1)
threshold Brier and 10-bin ECE for SOG>=1..5
metrics.primary: macro-game discrete CRPS (within a game mean CRPS of its candidate rows; across games mean; across folds equal weight)

prospective_discrete_calibration.interval: lo_i = smallest k with F_i(k) >= (1-c)/2, hi_i = smallest k with F_i(k) >= (1+c)/2
report: empirical coverage minus mean attainable mass
randomized-PIT central coverage = mean of I[(1-c)/2 <= PIT <= (1+c)/2] and |that - c|

models.A0: frozen Phase 1A B2 architecture refit on the exact bounded training population: Preprocessor(nhl_sog_phase1a_data.FEATURES) [training-only median imputation, explicit missing indicator for every continuous feature, training-only standardization] -> sklearn PoissonRegressor(alpha=0.001, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-6) -> NB2 dispersion by the frozen fixed-mean bounded MLE on training rows (log alpha in [1e-6,20])
models.A1: the SAME architecture with ONLY the four registered attempt features appended (feature order: CORE then ATTEMPTS_MEAN_APP5, ATTEMPTS_MEAN_APP10, ATTEMPTS_PER60_APP10, ON_NET_RATE_APP10); Poisson alpha stays 0.001; NB2 dispersion fit by the same procedure on training rows only
models.comparators_not_used: B3 may be cited only as Phase 1A context; no B3 model is fit or compared here
models.rows: A0 and A1 use exactly the same candidate rows; rows with missing attempt features stay in the sample

pass_gate.S1: relative improvement of the equal-weight mean over D1-D4 of fold macro-game CRPS, (mean A0 - mean A1) / mean A0, >= 0.5%
pass_gate.S2: one-sided 95% blocked-bootstrap upper bound of the pooled game-level delta (A1 - A0) < 0
pass_gate.S3: A1 has lower macro-game CRPS than A0 in at least 3 of 4 folds
pass_gate.S4: equal-weight mean over folds of macro-game NLL: (A1 - A0) / A0 <= +0.5%
pass_gate.S5: neither F nor D slice (pooled validation rows) with >= 500 rows has CRPS more than 5% worse than A0
pass_gate.S6: neither early-season nor established-season slice with >= 500 pooled validation rows has CRPS more than 5% worse than A0
pass_gate.S7: pooled randomized-PIT KS (A1 - A0) <= 0.02 AND, for c = 0.80 and 0.90, randomized-PIT central-coverage absolute error (A1 - A0) <= 0.02
pass_gate.fail_status: ATTEMPT_SIGNAL_NOT_JUSTIFIED (this exact attempt-feature branch is frozen: no rescue tuning, no variants, no full crawl)
pass_gate.pass_status: ATTEMPT_SIGNAL_FULL_CRAWL_JUSTIFIED (component candidate only: it does NOT replace B2 and starts no crawl in this task)

requirements: for every fetched source game and player present in the frozen official table: PBP-reconstructed SOG == frozen official SOG (ANY genuine mismatch -> STOP before model performance; diagnose parser defect / NHL correction-version / player attribution / shootout handling; never tolerate silently)
shootout events excluded (count of excluded SO events reported)
exactly one deterministic row per (game_id, player_id)
aggregation invariant to the order of PBP events (deterministic shuffle check on every fetched game)

content: candidate coverage (share of training candidate rows with a non-missing attempt feature)
raw_signal_diagnostics.use: descriptive only; no feature may be derived or changed from them
raw_signal_diagnostics.when: computed from TRAINING portions of each fold BEFORE any A1-vs-A0 validation scoring

sample.independence: no stratification and no use of SOG, teams, players, scores, model residuals or any outcome; calendar-month distribution is reported afterwards as a representativeness diagnostic only
sample.selection: key = SHA256('nhl-phase1b-a-v1|<game_id>') as lowercase hex; sort ascending by (key, game_id); take the first 200 per season (all games if fewer than 200)
sample.target_rows: all Phase 1A Phase-0B candidate-universe rows (nhl_sog_phase1a_data.build_prediction_rows) of the sampled target games, unchanged definitions
sample.universe: regular-season games in phase1a_data/games_<season>.jsonl.gz (completed regular season, season = start year of the game id)

scope: Bounded information-value screen: do LAGGED INDIVIDUAL SHOT ATTEMPTS add incremental information beyond the frozen Phase 1A B2 feature set? Decides ONLY whether a full PBP crawl is justified. It cannot promote a champion, does not reopen B3 and does not change any Phase 1A artifact.
